lines.speaker: stacks_swimmer
lines.text: Line's mine till the light goes. You can cross on it if you're quick and you don't put weight on the middle.

lines.speaker: stacks_swimmer
lines.text: Everyone here swims. My mother's mother's mother learned on the causeway, off a woman who told her the water was coming and taught her anyway.

lines.speaker: stacks_swimmer
lines.text: Sana, her name was. Nobody knows anything else about her. We've got a line named after her and that's the whole record.
